Organelle.subject: Important Days
Organelle.question: The _____ was Specialized subunit within a cell.
Organelle.fact: An organelle is a specialized subunit, within a biological cell, that has a specific function. The name organelle comes from the idea that these structures are parts of cells, as organs are to the body, hence organelle, the suffix -elle being a diminutive.
